final_text:
Done in one execution.

`out/T4/solution.py` loads the three checkpoints and, before touching anything, verifies: identical key sets (160 tensors), matching shapes/dtypes on every tensor, the 48 expected MLP names present, and bit-exact equality of all 112 non-MLP tensors across base/ft1/ft2 — each failure aborts with a descriptive `SystemExit`. The merge computes `base + 0.4*(ft1-base) + 0.4*(ft2-base)` in float32 from the *unmodified* base for each key (no in-place accumulation, so the second task vector isn't taken against an already-merged base), copies everything else from the base, asserts merged == 48 and output == 160, writes `out/T4/model.safetensors`, and re-reads it to confirm 160 tensors.

`out/T4/REPORT.md` is written per the template.
